toegepas.voor: Kos kan jou siek maak al lyk dit
toegepas.na: Kos kan jou siek maak, al lyk dit
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma separates the main clause from the concessive 'al'-clause, between the two verbs.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma where the main clause meets the concessive 'al'-clause (maak / al).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Punctuation fix only; the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: en skraap nie net die skimmel af nie
toegepas.na: en moenie net die skimmel afskraap nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: A negative instruction in Afrikaans takes 'moenie'; 'skraap nie ... af nie' reads as a statement, not an instruction.
toegepas.fout: 'skraap nie net ... af nie' reads as a statement where the paragraph gives a negative instruction, which takes 'moenie'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grammar fix; same instruction, same scope with 'net' kept.

toegepas.voor: Jou neus en oë vang dikwels bederf
toegepas.na: Jou neus en oë merk dikwels bederf op
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Vang' is an unnatural verb for noticing spoilage; 'opmerk' is the idiomatic choice and keeps 'dikwels' and 'gewoonlik'.
toegepas.fout: 'vang' copies English 'catch' and is an unnatural verb for noticing spoilage.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'opmerk' is the natural Afrikaans verb, and 'dikwels' and 'gewoonlik' stay intact.

toegepas.na: of daaruit proe as dit opgeswel
toegepas.rede_vinder: One tastes the food from the tin, not the tin itself; 'daaruit' makes the object clear.
toegepas.fout: 'proe' has the tin as its object, so the sentence literally says to taste the tin.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'daaruit' fixes the object without changing what the learner must not do.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Los' for 'leave behind' is colloquial; 'agterlaat' is the standard written form.
toegepas.fout: 'los' can be misread as 'loose/release'; for 'leave behind' it is colloquial and ambiguous.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'agterlaat' is plain, exact and keeps the meaning.

toegepas.na: ver van kos af en nooit
toegepas.rede_vinder: The idiom for keeping something away from something is 'ver van ... af hou'.
toegepas.fout: The fixed expression 'ver van ... af' is missing its 'af'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restores the fixed expression; the instruction is unchanged.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma separates the subject clause 'Wat oorbly' from the main verb, between two verbs.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma between the subject clause and the main verb (oorbly / mag).

toegepas.na: kry hulle nie noodwendig almal nie
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Almal' on its own usually refers to people; 'hulle almal' clearly points back to the listed signs and symptoms.
toegepas.fout: Bare 'almal' tends to read as people; it does not clearly point back to the listed signs and symptoms.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'hulle almal' makes the reference clear with the same meaning.

toegepas.voor: By kieme of bederf is 'n groot gevaar
toegepas.na: By kieme of bederf is daar 'n groot gevaar
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence lacks a formal subject; 'is daar' is required and leaves the protected 'n groot gevaar' intact.
toegepas.fout: The existential sentence lacks the required 'daar'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Grammar fix that leaves the protected 'n groot gevaar' intact.

toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma separates the main clause from the concessive 'al'-clause, between the two verbs.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma where the main clause meets the concessive 'al'-clause (drink / al).

toegepas.voor: bloed in die diarree of opgooi.
toegepas.na: bloed in die diarree of opgooisel.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Opgooi' is the verb; the substance in which blood is seen is 'opgooisel'.
toegepas.fout: 'opgooi' names the act; blood is seen in the vomited matter, 'opgooisel'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: More exact noun with no change to the warning sign itself.

laat_vaar.voor: kos wat klaar is om te eet
laat_vaar.na: kos wat gereed is om te eet
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Klaar is om te eet' echoes English 'ready to eat'; 'gereed' is the standard Afrikaans word here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'klaar' meaning ready is standard Afrikaans and also carries 'already prepared', so the swap is lateral and narrows the sense.

laat_vaar.voor: Siekte van kos met kieme, gif of bederf daarin noem ons voedselvergiftiging.
laat_vaar.na: As 'n mens siek word van kos met kieme, gif of bederf daarin, noem ons dit voedselvergiftiging.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The fronted object 'Siekte van kos ... daarin' is wooden; a conditional clause reads naturally with the same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'X noem ons Y' is a normal defining construction that mirrors the glossary entry; the proposal is longer and names the event rather than the illness.

na_skrywer.voor: Gaar kos staan nie langer as twee uur buite nie
na_skrywer.na: Laat gaar kos nie langer as twee uur buite staan nie
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The sentence is a rule for the learner but is phrased as a description; an instruction matches the surrounding imperatives.
na_skrywer.fout: The storage rule is phrased as a description rather than an instruction among imperatives.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: It rewrites a food-safety instruction (and the next block's 'ook net twee uur' leans on it), so the writer owns the wording.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: neem die grootmens hom met die houer
na_skrywer.na: neem die grootmens die siek mens saam met die houer
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Hom' has no clear antecedent after 'jy of iemand anders', and 'saam met' makes clear the container is taken along.
na_skrywer.fout: 'hom' has no clear antecedent after 'jy of iemand anders'.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Real fault, but the fix rewrites a poisoning safety instruction (who is taken, with what), which the writer owns.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

na_skrywer.voor: Hulle gaan ook kliniek toe as hy nie beter word nie.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Grootmens neem hom ook kliniek toe as hy nie beter word nie.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Hulle' has no clear antecedent; the previous sentences name the adult as the one who takes the sick person.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: Real fault, but the proposal changes who acts in a safety instruction ('they go' to 'an adult takes him'), so the writer must fix it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.teks: sonder om vir tekens te wag of hom te laat opgooi
vlae.rede: Not a language fault and not a safety flag: the protected entry says the pair 'tekens en simptome' must not be shortened to one word, and here 'tekens' alone may narrow the instruction (one should not wait for symptoms either). Changing it would alter meaning, so a writer or person should judge whether it is intended.
